claims.statement: There is a genuine five-bit Boolean function and physical coordinate i with Delta_i U>B_i+(4/3)Inf_i; hence K_i<=Gamma_i+c Inf_i is false universally for every c<=4/3.
For every genuine Boolean f, G(f)<=H(f)+I(f), equivalently sum_i(K_i-Gamma_i)<=I(f)+H(f)-sum_i B_i. Exhaustive survival through four variables and bounded random survival through seven are not proof.
For every rank-(m-2) shield, G(P)<=3I(P). The present local falsifier invalidates one proposed proof mechanism but does not refute the class claim.
No dimension-independent universal control with b<1 of the aggregate upper-set asymmetry mismatch is proved; coordinatewise coefficient tuning through 4/3 is now exactly obstructed.
